QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Assault! Mechanized Maverick Platoon
QuestInfo.0: You recovered the #t4032158# and turned it on, only to see a huge group of contacts coming in fast. This is going to get worse before it gets better...
QuestInfo.1: A robot army dropped down all around you. Not an army of industrial robots, but sleek, purpose-built killers. You don't know how much longer you can protect the pilot.
QuestInfo.2: You protected the pilot -- barely -- but something doesn't add up. What's an army of assassin bots doing in peacetime, and how did they know to come after this particular kid? Go see what #p9401533# has to say about it.
